notice.sentAt: integer Unix milliseconds generated by server
notice.expiresAt: integer Unix milliseconds; maximum seven days after sentAt
notice.headline: Notice headline

rules: Resend original IDs, timestamps and content; conflicting duplicate IDs are rejected.
A receipt must be acknowledged by receiptId, including duplicate receipts; publish success is not acknowledgment.
Queues are isolated by API origin and signed channel and stop when the session ends.
Chat, presence, remote calling and user-generated content writes are not added by this protocol.
